independence.method: Read chapter12 directly, independently recorded all42 membership triples, then matched literal direction clauses and initial ordered-pair enumerations in the same cached primary text. normalization.origin_aliases: [Gamma] ut and gamma ut refer to P01; sui resolves to the current pitch record. The first [Gamma] ut et sui phrase is preserved explicitly. Case distinguishes C/F/G from c/f/g. No octave collapse.
normalization.notation: [Gamma] and [sqb] remain TML notation placeholders; no new glyph reconstruction. Parenthetic grave/acute in two navigation labels disambiguates identically printed [sqb] mi records by source position.
normalization.markup: Only HTML tags and numbered page/folio markers removed for phrase matching; every original paragraph is hash-bound. No correction of Latin words.

source_rules.source_words: sub una clavi et eadem unisona transitio vocis in vocem
source_rules.meaning: A voice-to-voice transition under one same key at unison; not pitch motion between distinct keys.

source_rules.qualification: The voice obtaining force is the receiving voice, described as taking the melody of its predecessor. Directions in records were read explicitly and only afterward checked against this rule.

source_rules.source_order_description: first to last and reverse; first to middle and reverse; middle to last and reverse
source_rules.status: All six three-voice records follow the explicitly stated listing order.

source_rules.note: The source states that other voices belong ad usum the originating ut; ut alone does not constitute a complete cantus.

explicit_prohibitions.scope: All different claves, not only the B examples; mutation requires both same key and same unison sonority.
explicit_prohibitions.reason_given: Round b/fa and square b/mi are two keys, different letter shapes and monochord dimensions, not one key or one sonority.
cc sol fa lacks the principal ut and final la.
explicit_prohibitions.scope: Explicit source exclusion; do not add an eighth origin at cc.

record_caveats: P22 ee la is explicitly a modern addition in the historical source; retained as listed, not silently dropped.
Zero mutation is explicitly stated at each of the eight single-voice records; it is not inferred only from absence of a listed pair.
Several reverse pairs share the same direction (for example ut/re ascend both ways; sol/fa descend both ways). They are retained literally.
No target identity, modern pitch frequency, automatic key equivalence, or meaning claim is supplied.
